ns2:section.sectionText: Students registered in the online section will complete assessments online via PrairieLearn. Content is offered online via PrairieLearn to be completed asynchronously. This section is for students who either cannot take in-person lectures due to their schedule or prefer the flexibility of online learning. Discussion sections are in person. This class requires the use of a laptop. Students may be required to bring their own laptops to the discussion session. If you do not have the means to do so, the course instructor can provide a set of campus resources to assist you.
